items.title: S&P 500 Holds Steady as Fed Rate Hold Expectations Rise After Warsh Remarks
items.summary: The S&P 500 Index was little changed on Friday, as indications that the Federal Reserve will hold interest rates steady this month heartened investors despite continued worries about the viability of the artificial intelligence trade.

items.title: Fed’s Warsh sees AI boosting productivity but gives no signal on next rate hike

items.title: Fed chair Warsh says price stability is key but shies away from signals about rates
items.summary: U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh says he won't prejudge what the U.S. central bank will do about interest rates at its upcoming meetings. However, he repeatedly vowed to “deliver price stability.” Warsh spoke Friday on the sidelines of a meeting of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank in Bangkok. The global surge in prices is a key concern of the financial leaders meeting. Stubbornly high U.S. inflation is expected to lead the Fed to raise its key interest rate in coming months after a rate hike in September.
